edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner before completing the handover.
acceptOwnership moves newOwner into the owner state variable.
RoFIToken constructor initializes _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the entire supply to the fixed deployer address in balances.
transfer reads and updates balances[msg.sender] using the caller address.
transfer calls safeSub to deduct the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction without SafeMath.
_totalSupply is read as the minuend of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller as the allowance owner.
The spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
transferFrom calls safeSub to deduct from balance and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key in allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-supplied spender contract.
The untrusted receiveApproval callback executes before approveAndCall returns, enabling reentrancy.
approveAndCall records the allowance for msg.sender before the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards the call to the arbitrary token contract address.
The external token contract call returns control to transferAnyERC20Token.
The spender parameter selects the untrusted contract that is called back.
The tokens parameter is forwarded into the untrusted receiveApproval call.
The data parameter is forwarded as raw calldata into the untrusted receiveApproval call.
safeAdd first operand flows into the arithmetic guarded by require.
safeAdd second operand flows into the arithmetic guarded by require.
Local c receives the computed sum returned by safeAdd.
safeSub minuend flows into the guarded subtraction.
safeSub subtrahend flows into the guarded subtraction.
Local c receives the computed difference returned by safeSub.
safeMul first factor flows into the multiplication guarded by require.
safeMul second factor flows into the multiplication guarded by require.
Local c receives the computed product returned by safeMul.
safeDiv dividend flows into the division guarded by require.
safeDiv divisor flows into the division guarded by require.
Local c receives the computed quotient returned by safeDiv.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Recipient parameter to indexes balances in transfer.
Amount parameter tokens flows into the SafeMath calls of transfer.
Allowance amount parameter tokens is written into the allowed mapping by approve.
from parameter indexes balances and allowed in transferFrom.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
tokens parameter drives the SafeMath deductions and credit in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the outer allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the inner allowed mapping in allowance.
Arbitrary tokenAddress parameter selects the untrusted contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens parameter is forwarded into the external token transfer call.
